description: A command line utility script for pulling multiple change lists from Gerrit, including functions for building commands, handling repositories, and processing change lists.

classes.name: ChangeList
classes.description: Represents a change list to be checked out, with methods to determine if it is a merge commit.

classes.name: ProjectNameDirDict
classes.description: A dictionary mapping project names and revisions to source directory paths.

methods.name: _confirm
methods.description: Prompts a yes/no question and returns a boolean answer.

methods.name: find_repo_top
methods.description: Finds the top directory of the git repository.

methods.name: build_project_name_dir_dict
methods.description: Builds a mapping from Gerrit project names to source directory paths based on a manifest.

methods.name: group_and_sort_change_lists
methods.description: Groups and topologically sorts change lists by project.

methods.name: _main_json
methods.description: Outputs change lists in JSON format.

methods.name: build_pull_commands
methods.description: Constructs shell commands to pull a specific change.

methods.name: _sh_quote_command
methods.description: Converts a command list into a shell-quoted string.

methods.name: _sh_quote_commands
methods.description: Converts multiple commands into a single shell command string.

methods.name: _main_bash
methods.description: Prints bash commands to pull change lists.

methods.name: _do_pull_change_lists_for_project
methods.description: Performs pulling of change lists for a project, handling errors.

methods.name: _print_pull_failures
methods.description: Prints details of failed pull operations.

methods.name: _main_pull
methods.description: Main logic for pulling change lists, with parallel execution support.

methods.name: _get_change_lists_from_args
methods.description: Queries change lists based on command line args.

methods.name: _get_local_branch_name_from_args
methods.description: Determines local branch name from args or prompts user.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, dispatches commands based on arguments.
